description: The UI is a remote page (loopback sidecar proxy in packaged builds, localhost dev server in dev), so IPC from it is origin-gated. Grant only what the UI needs: start_dragging on mousedown and the double-click maximize toggle for the top-bar drag region, webview zoom for the Cmd+/− interface zoom, and opener open_url (scoped to http/https/mailto/tel by allow-default-urls) so the opener plugin's injected target=_blank click handler can hand external links to the system browser. Everything else stays app-origin-only.
